INSERT INTO user_memory ( user_id, session_id, memory_type, content, importance, evidence_message_id, evidence_text, superseded_by_memory_id, expires_at, embedding, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId},
CAST(#{sessionId} AS uuid) null , #{memoryType}, #{content}, #{importance},
CAST(#{evidenceMessageId} AS uuid) null , #{evidenceText},
CAST(#{supersededByMemoryId} AS uuid) null , #{expiresAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{embedding}::vector, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE user_memory SET superseded_by_memory_id = CAST(#{supersededByMemoryId} AS uuid), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND superseded_by_memory_id IS NULL
UPDATE user_memory SET embedding = #{embedding}::vector, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid)
UPDATE user_memory SET content = #{content}, embedding = #{embedding}::vector, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND user_id = #{userId}

UPDATE user_memory SET content = #{content}, embedding = #{embedding}::vector, expires_at = #{expiresAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND user_id = #{userId} AND superseded_by_memory_id IS NULL
UPDATE user_memory SET expires_at = #{expiresAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND user_id = #{userId} AND superseded_by_memory_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, session_id, memory_type, content, importance, evidence_message_id, evidence_text, superseded_by_memory_id, expires_at, embedding, created_at, updated_at FROM user_memory WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS uuid) AND user_id = #{userId} AND superseded_by_memory_id IS NULL

SELECT id, user_id, session_id, memory_type, content, importance, evidence_message_id, evidence_text, superseded_by_memory_id, expires_at, embedding, created_at, updated_at FROM user_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND superseded_by_memory_id IS NULL ORDER BY updated_at DESC

SELECT id, user_id, session_id, memory_type, content, importance, evidence_message_id, evidence_text, superseded_by_memory_id, expires_at, embedding, created_at, updated_at FROM user_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND superseded_by_memory_id IS NULL AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > NOW()) ORDER BY updated_at DESC

SELECT id, user_id, session_id, memory_type, content, importance, evidence_message_id, evidence_text, superseded_by_memory_id, expires_at, embedding, created_at, updated_at FROM user_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND content = #{content} AND superseded_by_memory_id IS NULL AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > NOW()) ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT id, user_id, session_id, memory_type, content, importance, evidence_message_id, evidence_text, superseded_by_memory_id, expires_at, embedding, created_at, updated_at, embedding <=> #{vectorLiteral}::vector AS distance FROM user_memory WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND embedding IS NOT NULL AND superseded_by_memory_id IS NULL AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > NOW()) ORDER BY embedding <=> #{vectorLiteral}::vector LIMIT #{limit}
